Name: No Kids for adults mods
Author: slpOff
Description:
Most of the conversations and festivals related to jas and vincent have been deleted, and some of Penny's schedule has also been modified.

This is a beta version that is still only in progress regarding deletion.

Related events have also been changed so that they can occur randomly.

>> jas and vincent's 6 hearts event was cleared of all content, keeping only the weather conditions.
>> Penny no longer walks around town alone.

It is still a beta version, and related content was simply searched and deleted, so the parts mentioned as kids, etc. are still alive.
So, if you tell me about that part, I will fix it.

Thanks :)
